QuestInfo.name: Eliminate the Tauromacis
QuestInfo.0: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go see Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
QuestInfo.1:
Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r30 Tauromacis#k and #r100 Cold Eyes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.

#o 7130100# #r#a22031##k
#o 4230100# #r#a22032##k
QuestInfo.2: I've eliminated 100 Tauromacis. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island.

0.0: Thank you for the wonderful job you did last time. Unfortunately, I don't think that was enough to prevent the evil spirits from reaching further. Can you help me once more?

yes.0: Thank you. This time, it's #r30 Tauromacis#k and #r100 Cold Eyes#k. Please take care of yourself.

no.0: You must be busy with other endeavors. That's unfortunate. I'll just have to look for other willing warriors.

1.0: That was fast. I knew you'd be able to do it. Hopefully your efforts will result in bringing in peace on Victoria Island.

yes.0: When the time of peace comes in Victoria Island, I know exactly who to thank for this. Let's hope that day will come soon.

mob.0: Please defeat 100 Tauromacis. They can be found in the deepest part of Victoria Island.
